candidate.title: Removing the multi-provider guard makes an ambiguous crypto classpath silently pick a provider instead of failing
candidate.description: Removing multi-provider guard causes ambiguous crypto provider selection to silently pick a provider based on jar order instead of failing. FIPS deployment that accidentally includes keycloak-crypto-default now boots on non-FIPS BouncyCastle instead of failing at startup as intended.
